notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/dropdown.md at 889444e. The guide's Sources note was checked on 13 October 2026 on the 12 October build (mirror v0.1.78-c1fa197, Biscuit's main at c1fa197, the #209 fix), so items citing it carry that build. The evidence's 28 September sections (Checked, Contract, Rendered and Limits, on 0.1.60) are out of date where its later checks say so: the menu and menuitem roles and the missing aria-selected (fixed by #173, checked 1 October on 5b6894b), the #185 keyboard regression on 3795b4c (fixed on 636f3f5) and Enter firing twice (#209, fixed on c1fa197). None of those sentences is used, and the Contract's default name “Dropdown menu” is out of date too: the installed default is “Dropdown options”. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c1fa197 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 changes no Dropdown file, nor typography.ts or web-platform-utils; Icon.tsx shows no line changes. Installed Dropdown.tsx matches every guide sentence used here but one, read from source, not run: the panel has radius 8, a soft 0 4 16 shadow, and no open state or position of its own; maxHeight wraps the items in a ScrollView; items are 100% wide; the label is one line with an ellipsis unless disableTruncation is set; the selected item gets the grey fill (rgb 245, 245, 245) and a 16 px check unless trailing is set; hover (web) and press use that same grey; a disabled item is at 0.4 opacity and ignores presses; on the web the panel is a listbox named by accessibilityLabel, its items are options with aria-selected, and disabled ones get aria-disabled; standalone options are tab stops (tabIndex 0, disabled -1), Space is handled by the item's own key handler and Enter by react-native-web's Pressable, so each calls onPress once (#185 and #209 stay fixed); neither Dropdown nor DropdownItem has an arrow-key handler, and DropdownInput sets omitFromTabOrder and handles the arrow keys itself. The exception is Sizing's “Items are 43 px tall” (Figma's 43): the label's line height goes through safeTextLineHeight, at least 1.2 × the 16 px font, so 20 px rather than the 19 px token, and an item is 12 + 20 + 12 = 44 px, already on c1fa197; the page's own size marks read 240 × 44 for an item and 240 × 132 for three. The sentence is kept as the guide's figure. DropdownItem has no entry and no facts of its own. As SkeletonGroup and TooltipContent were in earlier entries, the item props the guide relies on are evidence facts: label, leading and trailing from the 0.1.60 Contract and Rendered lines (still true in the installed source, but flagged as stale), selected, disabled and onPress from the 0.1.78 checks. The examples use DropdownItem as Dropdown's children, as the guide does, and the type-check accepts it. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every Dropdown, DropdownItem, Icon, Card and HStack) and no other modes, so the In context More button's Emphasis Low is left out, since no rule in this entry says it needs it. The widths (220 for the menu, 240 otherwise) are layout-only style from the guide, per Sizing's “The screen sets the width”. Press handlers are stubs; the Choices and Scrolling lists get them so the screen can pick, though the guide's static lists have none. Copy and data are the guide's own. Left out of examples (an entry carries at most three): the With leading icons list (Icon ic_wallet at 18 px, Icon's default size), the Disabled item list (Available option, Coming soon), the long-label list, the playground and its Last choice readout, the In context status line (“Menu closed”, page copy) and its open and closed toggle (the example shows the menu open), and the Don'ts. Not recorded: style and labelStyle beyond layout (the building rules keep style off Coin components); nativeID, focusable and activeDescendantId, which DropdownInput uses and the guide doesn't describe; DropdownItem's value, highlighted, children, disableTruncation, accessibilityHint, nativeID and omitFromTabOrder; and the Dropdown Item State mode, which DropdownItem resolves itself (Idle or Selected) from selected, so setting it doesn't change an item. The package also exports DropdownMenu and DropdownMenuItem, a separate menu surface for Figma's Dropdown Menu that its own docs call distinct from the Dropdown and DropdownItem pair; the guide doesn't mention it, so it isn't recorded. Gaps hold the two limits the guide and evidence state on 0.1.78: no arrow keys in a standalone Dropdown, and hover and press sharing the selected grey. Sorting (batch 6), after the cross-check: gap 1 now says only what the evidence says (a hovered item looks selected), not that only the check tells them apart.

evidenceFacts.name: DropdownItem.label
evidenceFacts.description: On DropdownItem: the item's text, on one line; a long label is cut with an ellipsis.
evidenceFacts.quote: A long label truncates to one line with an ellipsis.

evidenceFacts.name: DropdownItem.leading
evidenceFacts.description: On DropdownItem: content before the label, such as an Icon; a registry icon shows at 18 px in the brand gold when no colour is given.
evidenceFacts.quote: Leading icon: 18 px registry icon rendered in the brand gold when no colour is given.

evidenceFacts.name: DropdownItem.trailing
evidenceFacts.description: On DropdownItem: content after the label; when set, it replaces the selected item's check.

evidenceFacts.name: DropdownItem.selected
evidenceFacts.description: On DropdownItem: marks the current choice; on the web the option has aria-selected=true, so it is announced as selected.

evidenceFacts.name: DropdownItem.disabled
evidenceFacts.description: On DropdownItem: in a standalone Dropdown on the web, enabled options are tab stops (tabindex 0) and a disabled option leaves the tab order (tabindex -1).

evidenceFacts.name: DropdownItem.onPress
evidenceFacts.description: On DropdownItem: the press handler. In a standalone Dropdown, Enter and Space each call it once (#209 fixed), so an action item runs once.
evidenceFacts.quote: in a standalone Dropdown, Enter and Space each call an option's `onPress` once.

gaps.text: A standalone Dropdown has no arrow-key navigation: arrow keys don’t move between options (Tab, Enter and Space do). Inside DropdownInput the field handles the keyboard.

from.quote: arrow keys don’t move between options.

gaps.text: Hover and press use the same grey as selected, so a hovered item looks selected: there is no separate hover or pressed colour.
gaps.quote: Hover and press still use the same grey as selected.
